official_source: Renewable Energy Planning Database quarterly extract
scope: Renewable electricity planning projects above the source threshold, from application through operation and historical outcomes
coordinate_availability: Published X/Y project points; Great Britain rows treated as British National Grid; Northern Ireland excluded because its grid differs
explicit_process_or_technology: Technology Type explicitly identifies Anaerobic Digestion; CHP flag, development status, and electrical capacity are source fields
access_mechanism: Official CSV and XLSX bulk downloads
systematic_selection: Technology Type equals Anaerobic Digestion AND Country is England, Scotland, or Wales; all statuses retained
evidence_notes: Planning-project records are not asserted to be unique physical facilities; revised applications may share a site. Approximate OSGB36-to-WGS84 conversion is documented and source grid values are retained.

official_source: ADEME-supported hydrogen production and distribution sites
scope: Sites followed through ADEME hydrogen ecosystem funding agreements since 2019
coordinate_availability: Published latitude/longitude; dataset says parcel location when known and commune coordinate otherwise
explicit_process_or_technology: Site type explicitly distinguishes Production from Distribution; source publishes project status, planned MW, and kg H2/day
access_mechanism: Public Data Fair JSON API and full download
systematic_selection: Every row whose source site_type equals Production
evidence_notes: The description says production is mainly electrolysis, but the row schema does not assign a pathway per site; individual reactor/process technology therefore remains unasserted.

official_source: ADEME SEA Métha annual operating follow-up
scope: Annual operational reporting by supported or participating methanisation installations
coordinate_availability: Installation data exist in the authenticated service; no public coordinate-bearing facility export identified
explicit_process_or_technology: Methanisation installation and annual performance reporting are explicit
license_or_reuse_status: Most declared data are confidential; only non-identifying aggregates may be published
systematic_selection: No lawful public facility-level selection route established
evidence_notes: The official service states that, except for a few project keys, declared data are confidential and only non-nominative summaries may be disseminated.

scope: Active urban wastewater treatment plants reported under the Urban Waste Water Treatment Directive
coordinate_availability: Source-reported spatial points; public GeoPackage and services
explicit_process_or_technology: Treatment category, capacity and performance fields are explicit; categories include biological treatment and nutrient removal
license_or_reuse_status: EEA reuse policy permits reuse with acknowledgement unless otherwise indicated
access_mechanism: Direct GeoPackage download, ESRI REST and WMS
systematic_selection: A future layer can select active connected plants with non-null reported coordinates and named biological treatment categories
evidence_notes: This is a strong reusable candidate but is very large and reports treatment categories, not individual anaerobic digester/reactor technology. It should be handled as a separate wastewater expansion rather than mixed selectively into this depth sample.

scope: Mandatory registry of electricity/gas market units, including biomass and gas producers
coordinate_availability: Location data are public subject to privacy rules, but precision and availability vary by unit
explicit_process_or_technology: Biomass energy carrier and plant/unit attributes are explicit; anaerobic digestion is not consistently equivalent to the biomass generator unit
access_mechanism: Daily XML/CSV full export and web service
systematic_selection: Potential future rule requires verified biogas/biomethane technology fields and facility-level aggregation of multiple generator units
import_decision: DEFER — technology/facility model needs dedicated work
evidence_notes: The register records individual generators, and several generators can belong to one installation. Treating every biomass generator as an anaerobic digester would infer technology and duplicate facilities.

official_source: IEA Hydrogen Production and Infrastructure Projects Database
scope: Worldwide hydrogen production projects commissioned since 2000 plus announced/planned projects
coordinate_availability: Interactive map exists, but downloadable source-coordinate suitability was not verified in this round
explicit_process_or_technology: Production route, product, capacity and project status are expected project fields
access_mechanism: Free XLSX behind IEA account/IP connection and interactive tools
systematic_selection: Would require all production projects with actual source coordinates and explicit route/status fields
import_decision: BACKLOG — authenticated download and coordinate audit required
evidence_notes: Licence is clear, but a credential-free deterministic download and row-level source-coordinate audit were not established. No data were scraped from the map.

scope: Operating, idle, under-construction and recently shut refineries plus named downstream unit capacities
coordinate_availability: Individual-refinery XLSX provides location names/state but no confirmed latitude/longitude field
explicit_process_or_technology: Atmospheric distillation, reforming, cracking, coking and hydrotreating capacities are explicit
license_or_reuse_status: U.S. federal information is generally public domain; source attribution expected
systematic_selection: All individual-refinery rows could be selected if joined to an official source-coordinate identifier
evidence_notes: Excellent process/capacity depth, but adding coordinates from addresses or a third-party geocoder would violate the no-inference rule.

official_source: EIA Biofuels Plant Production Capacity Report
scope: All operating U.S. fuel ethanol, biodiesel, renewable diesel and other biofuel plants
coordinate_availability: Plant XLSX is facility-level but no confirmed source latitude/longitude field
explicit_process_or_technology: Fuel ethanol production category and plant capacity are explicit; a specific fermentation vessel/design is not
license_or_reuse_status: U.S. federal information is generally public domain; source attribution expected
systematic_selection: Fuel ethanol plant rows would be a systematic biochemical-production selection if source coordinates become available
evidence_notes: Facility and capacity data are strong, but state/city locations are not converted into inferred points.

scope: Coal and other solid-feedstock gasification plants producing fuels, chemicals, ammonia, fertilizer or power
coordinate_availability: City and province are listed; no facility latitude/longitude dataset identified
explicit_process_or_technology: Gasifier type, count, feedstock capacity and products are explicitly listed
license_or_reuse_status: Government-hosted, but underlying cooperative-agreement compilation lacks a clear dataset licence on the reviewed page
systematic_selection: Could select ammonia/chemical products systematically if licensed source coordinates existed
import_decision: BACKLOG — stale, city-only and reuse terms unclear
evidence_notes: The process detail is unusually strong, but city geocoding would be inferred and source accuracy is explicitly variable.
